title: Invincible - Sheet Plus
description: Comic-book polish for the Invincible system: character, challenge and vehicle sheets, all item sheets, the rich-text editor and chat cards (rolls collapsed and expanded, item, injury and power cards). Landing animations, portrait parallax, logo shine, animated bars. Experimental (off by default): blood for low Health, cracks for low Resolve, wound flash. Needs the Invincible system DOM (2.1.x).
